convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load a proprietary custom indicator 'FRASMAv2', and depends on external .mqh library (TradeAlgorithms.mqh) for all trade execution logic including position sizing, open, and close functions.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required before indicator is ready
TimeShiftSec - seconds per indicator timeframe bar
derived_values.used_by: UpSignalTime and DnSignalTime calculation for position open timing

other_exits: Buy close triggered when FRASMAv2 signal buffer[1]==2 (sell signal bar); Sell close triggered when FRASMAv2 signal buffer[1]==0 (buy signal bar)

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MMMode selects between: LOT=fixed lot size (MM=0.1 lots), FREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin, BALANCE=fraction of balance, LOSSFREEMARGIN=fraction of free margin minus losses, LOSSBALANCE=fraction of balance minus losses. The MM input (0.1) serves as either lot size or risk fraction depending on MMMode.

custom_logic_notes: The FRASMAv2 indicator uses buffer index 1 as a signal buffer with three states: 0=buy zone, 1=neutral, 2=sell zone. Entry logic: Long when previous signal bar (Value[1]) is 0 AND current signal bar (Value[0]) > 0 (transition from 0 to positive within buy zone). Short when previous signal bar (Value[1]) is 2 AND current signal bar (Value[0]) < 2 (transition within sell zone). The SignalBar parameter (default 1) shifts which bar is read, meaning signals are confirmed on the closed bar before the current one. The IsNewBar guard only applies when SignalBar!=0; when SignalBar==0, signals are recalculated every tick. Trade execution functions (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose) and GlobalVariableDel_ are all from TradeAlgorithms.mqh - their internal logic is not visible in this file. UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime are passed to position open functions suggesting time-gated entry or order management within the library.
python_conversion_notes: The FRASMAv2 custom indicator must be reverse-engineered or reimplemented in Python - its internal algorithm (Fractal-adaptive SMA v2) is not available from this file. The TradeAlgorithms.mqh library handles all trade execution including position sizing with 5 different MMMode options - each must be reimplemented. Signal logic is state-machine based (3-state: 0/1/2) rather than simple crossover, requiring careful replication of the buffer[1]==0/2 checks with buffer[0] confirmation. The new-bar guard with CIsNewBar class and LoadHistory history-preloading call are MT5-specific patterns that need Python equivalents. SL/TP are in points (not pips) - verify whether 1000/2000 need digit-adjustment for 5-digit brokers.
